locations.title: In Siene (Challenge)
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Push Viktor Novikov into the Seine River.

Follow the mission story "A Private Meeting" to escort Max Decker to the gardens for a meeting with Viktor Novikov. Blend in as a CICADA bodyguard or hide elsewhere in the gardens until the meeting is over. Viktor Novikov will then walk to a half-wall, leaving Agent 47 an opening to push Viktor into the Siene River.
